metaDescription: Hub City Tank Co replaces and removes home heating oil tanks across Greater Moncton and Southeast New Brunswick. Free written estimates, licensed and insured.
h1: Meet Hub City Tank Co, Moncton's Oil Tank Specialists
heroSub: We replace and remove residential heating oil tanks across Greater Moncton and Southeast New Brunswick. One trade, done properly, with a free written estimate before any work starts.
storyHtml:
If your home runs on heating oil, your tank probably never crosses your mind until something forces it to. Maybe an insurance renewal letter showed up asking for the tank's age, or you spotted rust and a damp patch on the basement floor. That moment is stressful, and it's exactly the moment we built Hub City Tank Co for.

We keep things simple by doing one kind of work and doing it well. That means oil tank replacement, old tank removal, and the trickier jobs like buried tank removal. When a tank is actively leaking, our 24/7 emergency line gets you a real person, not a machine.

We're based in Moncton and we work all over the Hub City area, from Dieppe and Riverview out to Shediac, Salisbury, Memramcook and Sackville. If you're anywhere in Westmorland, Albert or Kent county, you're in our service area. We know these neighbourhoods, the older housing stock, and what local insurers expect from an oil tank.

Every job starts the same way: a free written estimate with the full price in plain language, so there are no surprises on the invoice. We're licensed and insured, and if you're wondering what a new tank runs these days, our cost guide lays it out in real Canadian dollars. Call us at (506) 802-3471 or email info@hubcitytank.ca, and we'll get you sorted.

values.title: Straight answers
values.desc: You get a free written estimate with the full price before we touch a thing. If we think your tank has a few good years left, we'll tell you that too.

values.title: Respect for your home
values.desc: We lay down floor protection, pump out any remaining oil safely, and haul the old tank away. When we leave, the only sign we were there is the new tank.

values.title: There when it counts
values.desc: A leaking tank in January can't wait for office hours. Our 24/7 emergency line is answered around the clock, and leaks go to the front of the queue.

values.title: Local through and through
values.desc: We live and work in Greater Moncton, so we know the housing stock, the winters, and what New Brunswick insurers ask for. That local knowledge saves you time and back-and-forth.

faq.a: Yes. Hub City Tank Co is licensed and insured for residential oil tank work, and we're happy to show proof before the job starts. Your insurer can get a copy of the paperwork for their file too.

faq.q: How much does an estimate cost?
faq.a: Nothing. Estimates are free, written, and good for the price we quote. We come out, look at your setup, and hand you the full number with no obligation to book.

faq.q: What should I do if my tank is leaking right now?
faq.a: Call our 24/7 emergency line at (506) 802-3471. Shut off the tank valve if you can reach it safely, keep kids and pets away from the area, and don't try to move the tank yourself. We'll walk you through the next steps on the phone.
